title: Pan-Fried Wonton Pastry Bites
description: A crispy and savory Chinese-inspired appetizer made with wonton wrappers and filled with a mixture of chow fun and fun ingredients.
instructions: Cut the puff pastry into small squares.
Place a wonton wrapper in the center of each square.
Add 1-2 tablespoons of chow fun mixture to the center of each wonton wrapper.
Brush the edges of the pastry with water.
Fold the pastry into a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Heat 1-2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the pastry bites to the pan and cook until golden brown.
Transfer the pastry bites to a baking sheet.
Bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
